title: Pinwheels (nut butter and jelly tortilla roll-ups)
summary: Spread nut butter and jelly on an 8-inch flour tortilla, roll it into a tight log, pin it with five toothpicks, trim the ends, then slice between the toothpicks with dental floss and plate the pinwheels.
source: CaptainCook4D recipe text + task graph (Pinwheels); mistake hints from train split

nodes.name: Slice next pinwheel with floss
nodes.instruction_novice: Repeat with the floss: slide it under, center it between the next two toothpicks, cross the ends on top, and pull to make another pinwheel. Keep going until every toothpick has its own slice.
substeps: Slide the floss under the log between the next two toothpicks
Cross the floss ends over the top
Pull the ends apart to slice
Repeat until each toothpick has its own pinwheel
nodes.end_state: Another round pinwheel, each with one toothpick, sits separated on the board beside the remaining log.
nodes.view_hint: Down at the log and the cut pinwheels on the cutting board

checks.question: Has a new pinwheel been separated from the log since the last cut?
Does each cut pinwheel have exactly one toothpick in it?
Is floss, not a knife or scissors, being used?

mistakes.description: Switches to a knife for the remaining slices
mistakes.visual_cue: A knife pressing through the log, flattening the spiral
mistakes.correction: Stay with the floss for the rest of the slices; the knife squashes them.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up a knife

mistakes.description: Uses scissors instead of floss
mistakes.visual_cue: Scissors snipping at the log
mistakes.correction: Scissors won't give a clean round slice; use the floss again.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for scissors

mistakes.description: Cuts in the wrong place so one slice has two toothpicks and another has none
mistakes.visual_cue: A pinwheel with two toothpicks next to one with none
mistakes.correction: Cut halfway between the toothpicks so each pinwheel gets one pick.
mistakes.early_cue: Floss placed right beside a toothpick

mistakes.description: Stops slicing while a section with more than one toothpick remains
mistakes.visual_cue: A remaining piece of log with two or more toothpicks still in it
mistakes.correction: There's still a piece with more than one toothpick; keep slicing until each pinwheel has just one.

nodes.name: Discard tortilla ends
nodes.instruction_novice: Pick up the two cut-off end pieces and throw them away or set them aside off the board.
substeps: Pick up both end pieces from the board
Drop them in the trash or a scrap bowl
nodes.end_state: The cutting board shows only the trimmed log; the two end pieces are gone.
nodes.view_hint: Down at the cutting board around the log

checks.question: Are the cut-off end pieces gone from the cutting board?

mistakes.description: End pieces left on the board and later mixed with the pinwheels
mistakes.visual_cue: Ragged end pieces still lying next to the log or on the plate
mistakes.correction: Those ragged ends shouldn't be served; toss them before you slice.

mistakes.description: A good pinwheel discarded by mistake instead of an end piece
mistakes.visual_cue: A neat spiral slice with a toothpick dropped in the trash
mistakes.correction: Hold on, that's a good pinwheel. Only the ragged end pieces get thrown out.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up a toothpicked slice while heading to the trash

nodes.name: Wipe knife clean (after jelly)
nodes.instruction_novice: Wipe the jelly off the butter knife with a paper towel and set the knife down for later.
substeps: Take a paper towel
Pinch the blade in the towel and pull the knife through
Set the clean knife down on the board
nodes.end_state: The butter knife is clean and resting beside the tortilla, with a jelly-smeared paper towel nearby.
nodes.view_hint: The knife and paper towel in hands

checks.question: Is the knife blade clean with no jelly left on it?
Is a paper towel being used to wipe the knife?

mistakes.description: Knife is left dirty and not wiped
mistakes.visual_cue: Knife set down with jelly still on the blade; no paper towel used
mistakes.correction: Give the knife a wipe with a paper towel now so it's clean for trimming later.
mistakes.early_cue: Knife put down on the counter straight from the tortilla

mistakes.description: Wiping a spoon or other utensil instead of the butter knife
mistakes.visual_cue: A spoon is being wiped instead of the butter knife
mistakes.correction: It's the butter knife that needs cleaning; wipe that one.

nodes.name: Cross floss ends over top
nodes.instruction_novice: Bring the two floss ends up and cross them over the top of the log, one over the other.
substeps: Lift both floss ends up the sides of the log
Cross one end over the other on top
Keep the floss snug against the log
nodes.end_state: The floss wraps fully around the log, with the two ends crossed in an X on top.
nodes.view_hint: Down at the top of the log where the floss crosses

checks.question: Do the two floss ends cross each other on top of the log?
Is the floss still between the same two toothpicks?

mistakes.description: Ends lifted but not crossed, floss just forms a U around the log
mistakes.visual_cue: Both floss ends rise straight up on each side without overlapping
mistakes.correction: Cross the two ends over each other on top so the floss makes a full loop.

mistakes.description: Floss shifts off-center while crossing
mistakes.visual_cue: Floss now sits close to a toothpick instead of midway
mistakes.correction: The floss slipped; nudge it back to the middle between the toothpicks before pulling.

nodes.name: Slide floss under roll
nodes.instruction_novice: Take a length of dental floss and slide it under the log so it crosses the log sideways, at a right angle to its length.
substeps: Pull off a piece of floss about 12 inches long
Hold one end in each hand
Slip the floss under the log, running crosswise, not along it
nodes.end_state: A strand of floss runs under the log at a right angle, with its two ends sticking out on either side.
nodes.view_hint: Down at the log with both floss ends visible on either side

checks.question: Is a strand of floss under the log with an end out on each side?
Is the floss crossing the log at a right angle to its length?

mistakes.description: Floss placed along the length of the log instead of across it
mistakes.visual_cue: Floss runs parallel to the log with ends poking out the ends
mistakes.correction: Turn the floss so it runs across the log, not along it; you want to cut slices.
mistakes.early_cue: Floss ends held at the two ends of the log

mistakes.description: A knife or scissors picked up instead of floss
mistakes.visual_cue: A knife or scissors in hand approaching the log
mistakes.correction: Put that down and use the dental floss; it slices cleanly without squashing the roll.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for scissors or a knife

nodes.name: Spread jelly over nut butter
nodes.instruction_novice: Spread the jelly in a thin layer right on top of the nut butter, keeping that bare half-inch edge clear.
substeps: Drop the jelly onto the middle of the nut butter
Spread it gently outward with the flat of the knife
Keep the jelly inside the nut butter area, leaving the edge bare
nodes.end_state: A thin, shiny layer of jelly covers the nut butter, with the bare border still visible around the edge.
nodes.view_hint: Straight down at the whole tortilla

checks.question: Is jelly spread over most of the nut butter layer?
Is the bare border around the edge still clear of jelly?

mistakes.description: Jelly spread with a spoon instead of the butter knife
mistakes.visual_cue: A spoon is being dragged across the tortilla
mistakes.correction: Use the butter knife to spread the jelly evenly.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon in hand over the tortilla

mistakes.description: Jelly pushed out to the edge of the tortilla
mistakes.visual_cue: Jelly reaches the rim; no pale tortilla border visible
mistakes.correction: Scrape the jelly back from the edge so there's still half an inch bare; it will leak when rolled otherwise.
mistakes.early_cue: Knife strokes reach the edge of the tortilla

mistakes.description: Too much jelly piled in the middle instead of spread thin
mistakes.visual_cue: A thick mound of jelly in the center with bare nut butter around it
mistakes.correction: Spread the jelly thinner across the whole nut butter layer.

nodes.name: Pull floss to slice
nodes.instruction_novice: Pull the two floss ends firmly in opposite directions so the floss tightens and slices straight through the log.
substeps: Grip one end in each hand
Pull steadily and firmly in opposite directions
Keep pulling until the floss passes all the way through
Pull the floss out
nodes.end_state: The log is cut into two pieces at the floss line with a clean spiral face showing.
nodes.view_hint: Down at the cut line on the log

checks.question: Is the log separated into two pieces with a clean spiral cut face?
Was floss, not a knife or scissors, used to make the cut?

mistakes.description: Floss not pulled tightly enough so the roll is only dented, not cut
mistakes.visual_cue: A groove around the log but the pieces are still joined
mistakes.correction: Pull harder and keep going; the floss needs to go all the way through.
mistakes.early_cue: Hands move apart slowly with slack floss

mistakes.description: Scissors used instead of floss
mistakes.visual_cue: Scissors cutting the log or the floss cut away
mistakes.correction: Use the floss to slice, not scissors; it gives a clean round pinwheel.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up scissors

mistakes.description: Knife used instead of floss
mistakes.visual_cue: A knife pressing down on the log, squashing it
mistakes.correction: Put the knife down and slice with the floss so the roll doesn't get squashed.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for a knife

nodes.name: Place pinwheels on plate
nodes.instruction_novice: Pick up each pinwheel and set it on a plate, spiral side up, so you can see the swirl.
substeps: Pick up a pinwheel by its toothpick or sides
Set it on the plate with the cut spiral facing up
Repeat for all the pinwheels
nodes.end_state: All five pinwheels sit on a plate with their spiral faces up and a toothpick in each.

checks.question: Are all the pinwheels on the plate and none left on the cutting board?
Are the pinwheels placed with the spiral face up?

mistakes.description: Some pinwheels left behind on the cutting board
mistakes.visual_cue: One or more spiral slices still on the board while the plate is set aside
mistakes.correction: You've left a pinwheel on the board; add it to the plate.

mistakes.description: Pinwheels placed on their side so the spiral isn't visible
mistakes.visual_cue: Slices lying on their curved edge with the toothpick horizontal
mistakes.correction: Turn them so the swirl faces up; it looks nicer and they sit stable.

mistakes.description: Discarded end pieces added to the plate
mistakes.visual_cue: Ragged, toothpick-less end pieces among the neat pinwheels
mistakes.correction: Those are the trimmed ends; take them off the plate.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up an end piece from the board

nodes.name: Secure roll with 5 toothpicks
nodes.instruction_novice: Push five toothpicks straight down through the log, spaced about an inch apart, to hold it closed.
substeps: Hold the seam closed with one hand
Push the first toothpick straight down through the roll near one end
Add the next toothpick about an inch over
Continue until five toothpicks are evenly spaced along the log
nodes.end_state: Five toothpicks stand upright in a straight row along the log, roughly one inch apart.
nodes.view_hint: Down along the top of the log so all toothpicks are visible

checks.question: Are exactly five toothpicks in the log?
Are the toothpicks evenly spaced about an inch apart in a line?

mistakes.description: Toothpicks inserted at random uneven spacing
mistakes.visual_cue: Gaps between toothpicks vary widely, some bunched together and some far apart
mistakes.correction: Those toothpicks are uneven. Pull them out and re-space them about one inch apart.
mistakes.early_cue: Second toothpick placed right next to or far from the first

mistakes.description: Wrong number of toothpicks
mistakes.visual_cue: Fewer or more than five toothpicks sticking out of the log
mistakes.correction: You need five toothpicks in total, about an inch apart. Adjust the count.
mistakes.early_cue: Only a few toothpicks taken from the box

mistakes.description: Toothpicks inserted at an angle or only through the top layer
mistakes.visual_cue: Toothpicks leaning sideways or barely poking into the log
mistakes.correction: Push each toothpick straight down through the whole roll so it holds the seam.

nodes.name: Scoop jelly with knife
nodes.instruction_novice: With the clean butter knife, scoop a dollop of jelly out of the jelly jar.
substeps: Open the jelly jar
Dip the clean butter knife in
Lift out a dollop of jelly on the blade
nodes.end_state: The butter knife is out of the jar with a glossy blob of jelly on its blade.
nodes.view_hint: The open jelly jar and the knife in hand

checks.question: Is jelly visible on the butter knife blade?
Is the utensil a dull butter knife rather than a spoon or sharp knife?

mistakes.description: A spoon is used instead of a butter knife
mistakes.visual_cue: A spoon dips into the jelly jar
mistakes.correction: Use the butter knife for the jelly too; it spreads more evenly than a spoon.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks up a spoon

mistakes.description: A sharp kitchen knife is used instead of a butter knife
mistakes.visual_cue: A pointed sharp blade goes into the jelly jar
mistakes.correction: Switch to the butter knife so you don't slice the tortilla while spreading.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches toward the knife block

nodes.name: Spread nut butter on tortilla
nodes.instruction_novice: Spread the nut butter in an even layer over the tortilla, but stop about half an inch before the edge all the way around.
substeps: Drop the nut butter in the center of the tortilla
Push it outward with the flat of the butter knife
Stop about half an inch from the edge all the way around
Scoop more if needed to cover evenly
nodes.end_state: The tortilla has an even brown layer of nut butter with a clean bare ring about half an inch wide around the edge.
nodes.view_hint: Straight down at the whole tortilla on the cutting board

checks.question: Is nut butter spread over most of the tortilla surface?
Is there an uncovered ring of tortilla visible around the edge?

mistakes.description: Nut butter is spread all the way to the edge with no border
mistakes.visual_cue: Brown nut butter reaches the rim of the tortilla with no pale tortilla showing
mistakes.correction: Scrape the nut butter back from the edge so about half an inch is bare; otherwise it squeezes out when you roll.
mistakes.early_cue: Knife strokes extend past the edge of the tortilla

mistakes.description: Spreading with a spoon instead of a butter knife
mistakes.visual_cue: A spoon back is being dragged across the tortilla
mistakes.correction: Use the butter knife to spread; the spoon leaves it lumpy.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon in hand over the tortilla

mistakes.description: Only a small patch is covered; tortilla left mostly bare
mistakes.visual_cue: Large pale areas of tortilla with nut butter only in the middle
mistakes.correction: Scoop a little more and spread it out until only the half-inch border is bare.

nodes.name: Scoop nut butter with butter knife
nodes.instruction_novice: Pick up a butter knife, open the nut butter jar, and scoop out a good spoonful of nut butter on the blade.
substeps: Pick up the butter knife, not a sharp knife or spoon
Open the nut butter jar
Dip the knife in and lift out a generous dollop
nodes.end_state: The butter knife is out of the jar with a visible lump of nut butter on its blade.
nodes.view_hint: The open nut butter jar and the knife in hand

checks.question: Is the tool in hand a rounded, dull butter knife?
Is there nut butter on the knife blade?

mistakes.description: A spoon is used instead of a butter knife
mistakes.visual_cue: A spoon with a bowl-shaped end is dipped into the jar
mistakes.correction: Swap the spoon for a butter knife; the flat blade spreads much more evenly.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picks a spoon from the drawer or utensil holder

mistakes.description: A sharp kitchen knife is used instead of a butter knife
mistakes.visual_cue: A pointed blade with a sharp edge goes into the jar
mistakes.correction: Put the sharp knife down and use a butter knife, so you don't cut the tortilla when spreading.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for the knife block or a chef's knife

nodes.name: Trim ends of roll
nodes.instruction_novice: Use the butter knife to cut off the ragged ends of the log, leaving about half an inch between the last toothpick and each cut end.
substeps: Pick up the clean butter knife
At one end, line the knife up half an inch outside the last toothpick
Press and saw gently to cut off the end piece
Repeat at the other end
nodes.end_state: Both ends of the log are cut flat, each about half an inch past the outer toothpicks, with two small end pieces lying on the board.
nodes.view_hint: Down at both ends of the log on the cutting board

checks.question: Are both ends of the log cut flat and square?
Is the gap between each outer toothpick and the cut end about half an inch?
Is a butter knife being used for the trim?

mistakes.description: A sharp kitchen knife used instead of the butter knife
mistakes.visual_cue: A pointed sharp blade cutting the log
mistakes.correction: Use the butter knife to trim, as the recipe calls for.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for the knife block

mistakes.description: Too much margin left, about an inch beyond the last toothpick
mistakes.visual_cue: A long unpinned stretch of log beyond the outer toothpick, roughly the same as the toothpick spacing
mistakes.correction: That end is too long. Trim a bit more so only about half an inch is left past the last toothpick.
mistakes.early_cue: Knife positioned far from the outer toothpick

mistakes.description: Ends not actually trimmed; cut not completed through the log
mistakes.visual_cue: Ragged, unrolled ends still attached, or a partial cut mark only
mistakes.correction: Saw gently back and forth with the butter knife until the end piece comes all the way off.
mistakes.early_cue: Knife pressed once then lifted away

nodes.name: Place tortilla on cutting board
nodes.instruction_novice: Take one 8-inch flour tortilla and lay it flat on the cutting board. Don't heat it, just use it as it is.
substeps: Get one 8-inch flour tortilla from the package
Place the cutting board on the counter in front of you
Lay the tortilla flat in the middle of the board, smoothing out folds
nodes.end_state: A single round flour tortilla lies flat and centered on the cutting board.
nodes.view_hint: Looking down at the cutting board on the counter

checks.question: Is a flour tortilla lying flat on a cutting board?
Is the tortilla resting on a cutting board rather than a plate?

mistakes.description: Tortilla is placed on a plate instead of a cutting board
mistakes.visual_cue: The tortilla sits on a round ceramic plate with a raised rim instead of a flat board
mistakes.correction: Move the tortilla onto the cutting board; you'll need the flat board for rolling and trimming.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for a plate from the cupboard or rack instead of the cutting board

mistakes.description: Tortilla is toasted or heated in a pan before being used
mistakes.visual_cue: A pan on the stove with the tortilla in it, or browned spots on the tortilla
mistakes.correction: No need to heat the tortilla. Use it straight from the package so it stays soft and rolls without cracking.
mistakes.early_cue: Stove is turned on or a pan is placed on a burner

nodes.name: Roll tortilla into a log
nodes.instruction_novice: Starting at one edge, roll the tortilla up snugly into a log about an inch and a half thick. Keep it tight enough that there are no gaps, but not so tight that filling squeezes out.
substeps: Lift one edge of the tortilla and fold it over the filling
Keep rolling toward the far edge, tucking as you go
Press gently so there are no air gaps inside
Finish with the seam side down
nodes.end_state: A snug tortilla log about 1.5 inches thick lies seam-side down on the board with no filling oozing out.
nodes.view_hint: Down at the log on the cutting board, including its open ends

checks.question: Is the tortilla fully rolled into a log shape?
Is the log about 1.5 inches thick, not fat and loose?
Are the sides and ends free of leaked filling?
checks.roi: seam and ends of the log

mistakes.description: Rolled too tight so filling leaks out
mistakes.visual_cue: Nut butter or jelly squeezing out of the ends or along the seam onto the board
mistakes.correction: That's rolled too tight and the filling is leaking. Ease off a little and wipe the extra off the ends.
mistakes.early_cue: Filling bulging at the edges while rolling

mistakes.description: Rolled too loose so the log is thick with gaps
mistakes.visual_cue: Log looks about 2.5 inches thick with visible air gaps in the spiral at the end
mistakes.correction: That roll is too loose. Unroll it and roll again snugly so the log is about an inch and a half thick.
mistakes.early_cue: Large loose first fold at the start of the roll

mistakes.description: Rolling started before the knife was cleaned, or tortilla folded instead of rolled
mistakes.visual_cue: Tortilla folded in half like a taco instead of a spiral log
mistakes.correction: Don't fold it, roll it from one edge to the other into a log.
mistakes.early_cue: Tortilla edge lifted and brought across to the opposite edge in one motion

nodes.name: Position floss between toothpicks
nodes.instruction_novice: Slide the floss along until it sits halfway between two toothpicks.
substeps: Pick a pair of neighboring toothpicks
Shift the floss sideways under the log
Stop when it is centered between those two toothpicks
nodes.end_state: The floss sits under the log exactly midway between two adjacent toothpicks.
nodes.view_hint: Down at the top of the log where the floss passes between toothpicks

checks.question: Is the floss centered midway between two neighboring toothpicks?

mistakes.description: Floss positioned right next to or against a toothpick
mistakes.visual_cue: Floss touching or almost touching one toothpick with a big gap to the next
mistakes.correction: Slide the floss over so it's right in the middle between the two toothpicks, or that slice won't have a pick to hold it.

mistakes.description: Floss positioned outside the outer toothpick in the end margin
mistakes.visual_cue: Floss between the outer toothpick and the cut end of the log
mistakes.correction: That's the trimmed end. Move the floss between two toothpicks instead.

nodes.name: Wipe knife clean (after nut butter)
nodes.instruction_novice: Wipe the nut butter off the butter knife with a paper towel so it's clean for the jelly.
substeps: Tear off a paper towel
Pinch the blade in the towel and pull the knife through
Check both sides of the blade are clean
nodes.end_state: The butter knife blade is shiny and free of nut butter, with a smeared paper towel on the counter.
nodes.view_hint: The knife and paper towel in hands

checks.question: Is the knife blade clean with no nut butter on it?
Is a paper towel being used to wipe the knife?

mistakes.description: Knife is not wiped before going into the jelly
mistakes.visual_cue: Knife with brown nut butter still on it heads to the jelly jar
mistakes.correction: Wipe the knife on a paper towel first so you don't get nut butter in the jelly.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaches for the jelly jar with a dirty knife

mistakes.description: Picks up a different utensil such as a spoon or sharp knife instead of cleaning the butter knife
mistakes.visual_cue: Butter knife set aside dirty and a spoon or sharp knife picked up
mistakes.correction: Stick with the butter knife; just wipe it clean and keep using it.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand moves to the drawer or knife block
